name: Shanghai yuefenpai calendar poster
summary: Artists drew a beauty in rubbed charcoal and tinted it with watercolour. Printers copied the result by chromolithography for tobacco, medicine and cloth advertisers. A calendar band runs along the foot.

philosophy.core_thesis: A calendar that a shop gives away can sell a product through the face of a modern woman, in smooth, warm colour that a lithograph can copy.
design_principles: Draw a young woman, in a qipao or a modern dress, in a fashionable room or garden.
Model the skin with rubbed charcoal and thin watercolour, so the tone is smooth and has no line.
Use hot, soft colour: peach skin, rose red, jade green and gold yellow.
Print a calendar band at the foot, with the months, and put the advertiser name and logo in a fixed place.
Frame the figure with a border of gold or pattern, and add a few props of the new city, such as a car, a radio or a lamp.
Make 4–8 lithographic plates, and print the full set in a large run for the advertiser.
Print on coated poster paper, and keep the register within 0.4 mm.
anti_patterns: A woodblock line or a folk-print outline
Visible halftone dots, or a photograph
Flat vector fill with no skin modelling
A calendar band that is missing or has no advertiser

process.matrix: Lithographic stones or zinc plates, one for each colour, made from a separation of the original.
process.press: A flatbed or offset lithographic press.
process.image_making: A painter makes an original in rubbed charcoal and watercolour. A printer separates it by hand or with a camera.
process.edition: Tens of thousands of sheets for an advertiser.

inks.strategy: Oil-based lithographic ink, 4–8 passes of transparent colour that mix on the sheet.

screening.rule: Copy the smooth rubbed tone with the grain of the stone or the plate, at about 100 lines an inch in the finest areas.

registration.rule: Keep each plate within 0.4 mm. A small gap shows at the edge of the skin or of the dress.

substrate.finish: A smooth coat with a slight shine.

surface.impression: None. The ink lies flat on the surface.
surface.sheen: A slight shine from the coat and from the oil ink.
surface.texture: Smooth skin tone, a soft rub texture in the shadow, and a bright, hot colour.

marks: smooth skin tone like an airbrush

positive: soft rub and watercolour skin tone

evidence.title: Advertisement poster for a cigarette company, Shanghai
evidence.credit: Wikimedia Commons. The Commons record gives the advertiser and the date 1930; the artist and the date are not checked.

emotion.target_response: A warm, modern glamour: the viewer sees a young woman of the new Shanghai, soft, bright and for sale.

use_cases: retro posters and packs for Shanghai themes
film and game art for 1930s Shanghai
avoid_when: The brief needs a rough, hand-cut or folk look.
The picture needs a photographic or a minimal flat style.

modifiers.how: Flatten the skin to flat tints, add a bold outline and large display lettering.
Replace the smooth skin by a block outline with flat vermilion and green, and add hand-painted faces.
